agreement_title.description: The agreement's title as printed at the top of the first page, e.g. 'MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH ...'

envelope_id.description: The e-signature envelope ID printed in the page header

county.description: The governmental customer party to the agreement

name.description: The county's name as defined in the opening paragraph

state.description: The state the county is in

service_provider.description: The vendor party to the agreement

name.description: The service provider's name as defined in the opening paragraph

initial_term_months.description: Length of the initial term in months, from the Effective Date and Term section

automatic_renewal_terms.description: Maximum number of automatic one-year renewal terms

not_to_exceed_amount_usd.description: The not-to-exceed contract amount in USD, from the Consideration and Compensation section

late_payment_statute.description: The statute governing payment and overdue invoices, e.g. 'Chapter 2251 of the Texas Government Code'

venue.description: The venue for disputes named in the Venue and Applicable Law section

governing_law.description: The state whose laws govern the agreement

audit_retention_years.description: Number of years after final payment the County may audit the provider's records

audit_notice_days.description: Days of advance notice the County gives before an audit

assignment_permitted.description: Whether the service provider may assign the agreement

signatures.description: Signature blocks on the master agreement signature page, one per party

party.description: The party heading over the signature block

signed.description: Whether a signature appears in the block

printed_name.description: The printed name in the block, if filled in

date.description: The signature date as YYYY-MM-DD, if filled in

order_form.description: Exhibit A, the vendor's order form attached to the agreement

account_number.description: Account Number in Contract Records; null if blacked out

order_number.description: Order # in Order Details; null if blacked out

valid_until.description: Valid Until date in Order Details, as YYYY-MM-DD

billing_address.description: Billing Address as printed, lines joined with ', '

payment_term.description: Payment Term under Payment Terms, e.g. 'Net 30'

order_notes.description: The Notes text under Payment Terms

subscription_periods.description: Each subscription pricing table, in order

period_label.description: The heading over the table, e.g. 'Prorated to Shift Dates'

item.description: Product or service name in the Item column

type.description: Billing type in the Type column, e.g. 'Recurring'

total_usd.description: Total (USD) for the line, as a number

period_total_usd.description: The table's TOTAL line, in USD

sales_tax_included.description: Whether the price includes sales tax

vendor_signer_title.description: Title of the vendor's authorized representative on the order form

vendor_signature_date.description: Date the vendor signed the order form, as YYYY-MM-DD
